research.notes:
**Intel (INTC), 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-30**

**1. Guidance and results**
- Q3 revenue was $16.5B (+21% y/y). Non-GAAP EPS was $0.52 against $0.40 expected, and revenue was roughly in line at $16.5B expected. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/intel-intc-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html
- Q3 non-GAAP gross margin was 44.1%, above guidance. The July EPS guide was $0.38. — 2026-10-29 — https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/INTC/earnings/INTC-Q3-2026-earnings_call-714242.html
- Q4 guidance is revenue of $15–16B and non-GAAP EPS of $0.25. LSEG consensus was $17.1B and $0.43. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/intel-intc-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html
- Q4 non-GAAP gross margin is guided to about 38%, with GAAP EPS of $0.10. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000050863/000005086326000188/q326earningsrelease.htm
- The guide includes a Fab 28 (Israel) shutdown, which management put at about $300M of Q4 revenue and about 200 bps of gross margin. A similar impact is expected in Q1. — 2026-10-29 — https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/intel-corp-intc-q3-2026-051348065.html
- CFO Zinsner expects the PC slowdown to last at least through 1H27. The stock fell more than 20% after hours. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/intel-intc-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html
- Benzinga says the stock fell about 28–29% on 2026-10-30 and was on pace for its worst day since 1974. — 2026-10-30 — https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/downgrades/26/10/62742459/intel-stock-worst-day-since-1974-bank-of-america-downgrade
- I found no pre-announcements or withdrawals in the period.

- BofA (Arya) cut to Neutral from Buy, PT $145→$100. — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/intel-guidance-analyst-price-targets.html
- Roth cut to Neutral, PT $120→$70. Seaport Global also cut to Neutral. — https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/downgrades/26/10/62742459/intel-stock-worst-day-since-1974-bank-of-america-downgrade

  - JPMorgan $85→$80

**3. Litigation and regulation**
- Law firm SBS announced an "investigation" on behalf of Intel investors. This is a plaintiff-firm solicitation, not a filed suit. — 2026-10-30 — https://stockhouse.com/news/press-releases/2026/10/30/intc-investors-with-100-000-in-losses-have-opportunity-to-join-intel-corporation

These are analyst claims, not company-confirmed. — 2026-10-15 — https://wccftech.com/keybanc-says-intel-has-won-contracts-from-broadcom-google-apple-amd-microsoft-and-nvidia-while-amazon-anthropic-and-spacexs-terafab-continue-to-evaluate-its-14a-and-18a-p-processes/

- I did not find the Q3 10-Q's major-customer percentages.

**5. Insider activity**
- I found no Form 4 open-market sales or purchases dated within 09-30 to 10-30.
- The most recent filing found is CEO Lip-Bu Tan's purchase of 105,263 shares at $95.00 (about $10M) via a family trust. — 2026-08-11 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000050863/000005086326000177/form4.xml
- An aggregator reports insider sales of $6.5M over about 7 months, none under 10b5-1 plans. I could not confirm this independently, and it falls outside the window. — date unknown — https://nexqual.com/INTC

**6. Product and competitive**
- Clearwater Forest (18A server) is shipping for revenue. Diamond Rapids (18A-P) is sampling and on track to ramp in 2027. — 2026-10-29 — https://rallies.ai/news/intel-ceo-clearwater-forest-its-first-intel-18a-server-product-is-shipping-for-revenue-4a46e04e2133164d

- BofA said Intel's data-center products are "not yet technically competitive" with faster-growing rivals. — 2026-10-30 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/intel-guidance-analyst-price-targets.html

writeup.headline: Intel rates Sell: strong balance sheet and growth outweighed by steep valuation, weak margins and a disappointing outlook.
writeup.thesis: Intel scores 42, a Sell, held down mainly by valuation (score 7): in absolute terms the multiples are high at 8.2x sales, 129.9x free cash flow and 275.5x EV/EBIT, with an FCF yield 4.2 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, and P/S is more expensive than at 56 of the last 61 month-ends. Quality is weak (score 39), with a 2.9% operating margin, a 6.3% FCF margin and diluted share count up 17.1% year on year. News risk (score 32) reflects Q4 guidance of $15–16B revenue and $0.25 non-GAAP EPS, well below consensus, followed by several downgrades. Offsetting this, growth is decent (score 59) with TTM revenue growth of 12.1%, though growth slowed by 4.5 pp from the previous quarter, and the balance sheet is strong (score 93) with net cash. The trend score of 47 is middling, with the price 34.7% below its 52-week high and shares 10.1 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days.
key_risks: Q4 guidance well below consensus and management expects the PC slowdown to last at least through the first half of next year
High absolute valuation leaves little room for further disappointment
Thin 2.9% operating margin and heavy dilution, with diluted share count up 17.1% year on year
Analyst downgrades from BofA, Roth and Seaport Global, with concerns that data-center products are not yet technically competitive
Price 9.4% below its 50-day average and lagging SPY and QQQ
what_would_change: A 3-point score gain would lift the rating to Hold, for example from improved news sentiment if foundry customer wins are confirmed
Better operating margins or slower share dilution would raise the quality score
A fall of 13 points would push it to Strong Sell, for example if growth decelerates sharply or guidance is cut further
A lower share price relative to sales and cash flow would lift the very low valuation score
